verdict.rationale: Mintlify Automations run the Mintlify agent on a schedule, on repository pushes, or on connected integration events [mintlify-docs-5]. A redesign added pre-built automations for common use cases [mintlify-docs-57], and automation updates are billed per delivered result [mintlify-docs-58]. Scheduling is limited to agent-driven content maintenance rather than arbitrary jobs, and the evidence gives only summary-level detail. Missing for 10: schedule configuration details (cadence/cron granularity, run history), support for general-purpose workflows beyond doc maintenance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
